description: This file defines the Trigger class used in Apache Spark's Structured Streaming to specify different trigger policies for streaming queries, including processing time, continuous, real-time, and available-now triggers.

classes.name: Trigger
classes.description: Defines various trigger policies for Spark Structured Streaming queries, including processing time, continuous, real-time, and available-now triggers.

methods.name: ProcessingTime
methods.description: Creates a processing time trigger with interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: ProcessingTime
methods.description: Creates a processing time trigger with interval and TimeUnit (Java-friendly).

methods.name: ProcessingTime
methods.description: Creates a processing time trigger with a Scala Duration.

methods.name: ProcessingTime
methods.description: Creates a processing time trigger with interval specified as a String.

methods.name: Once
methods.description: Creates a trigger that processes all available data once and then terminates (deprecated).

methods.name: AvailableNow
methods.description: Creates a trigger that processes all available data at the start and then terminates.

methods.name: Continuous
methods.description: Creates a continuous processing trigger with interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: Continuous
methods.description: Creates a continuous trigger with interval and TimeUnit.

methods.name: Continuous
methods.description: Creates a continuous trigger with a Scala Duration.

methods.name: Continuous
methods.description: Creates a continuous trigger with interval specified as a String.

methods.name: RealTime
methods.description: Creates a real-time trigger with batch duration in milliseconds.

methods.name: RealTime
methods.description: Creates a real-time trigger with batch duration and TimeUnit.

methods.name: RealTime
methods.description: Creates a real-time trigger with a Scala Duration.

methods.name: RealTime
methods.description: Creates a real-time trigger with duration specified as a String.

methods.name: RealTime
methods.description: Creates a default real-time trigger with a 5-minute batch duration.
